gerundive expressing what must or can be drawn or written
instrumental singular feminine of lekhinī; instrument of delineation
first member qualifying the following token as a compound expression for the instrument
instrumental singular feminine of pakṣa/pakṣā in the sense of feather; completes the instrument description with preceding token

items.question: What impossible instrument is required to delineate the uneven one?
premises: The uneven one is presented as something to be delineated.
Delineation requires an instrument such as a stylus.
The specified instrument is a crow's feather.
items.inference: Depicting the uneven one is framed as requiring an incongruous or impossible means.
uncertainties: The exact referent of viṣamaṣī is not specified in this verse alone.
Whether kāka and pakṣayā form a single compound or a loose juxtaposition is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: The uneven one is to be delineated with a stylus made of a crow's feather.
